cards.name: 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom
cards.officialOcgText: リバース：相手フィールド上に表側表示で存在するレベル４モンスターを全て破壊する。
cards.officialText: FLIP: Destroy all Level 4 monsters your opponent controls.
cards.condition: all face-up Level 4 monsters controlled by the opposing team
cards.historicalEligibility: TCG and OCG first printings are before 2004-09-30

twoVTwoAdaptation.fieldZone: separate and never a monster target
twoVTwoAdaptation.effectController: the team controlling the source when it flips resolves the effect; resolver seat must belong to that team
twoVTwoAdaptation.oldVindictive: target exactly one monster controlled by the opposing team at activation; face-down monsters can be targeted by slot without revealing their identity; if target leaves the field before resolution, it is not destroyed
twoVTwoAdaptation.ladybug: no targets; at resolution destroy every face-up Level 4 monster currently controlled by the opposing team; face-down Level 4 monsters are excluded by the official OCG wording
twoVTwoAdaptation.physicalOwnership: destroyed monsters enter the shared Graveyard of the team belonging to the physical owner seat, not the current controller team
twoVTwoAdaptation.protection: destructionProtected input models applicable destruction protection/replacement; protected monsters remain on field and do not release their zones
twoVTwoAdaptation.privacy: target option projections hide face-down card IDs and never expose physical UIDs; destroyed cards become public when placed in the shared Graveyard
twoVTwoAdaptation.sourceDeparture: FLIP trigger remains valid if battle destruction removes its source after the flip event and before trigger activation

limits: Pure helpers do not mutate field or Graveyard state.
Actual card certification requires registration in the shared resolver and real 2v2/Discord integration tests.
